mapper.sql: SELECT DATE(payments.confirmed_at) AS date, payments.amount AS salesRevenue, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(15,2)) AS serviceRevenue, 1 AS paidSessionCount FROM payments INNER JOIN sales_sessions ON sales_sessions.id = payments.sales_session_id WHERE sales_sessions.store_id = #{storeId} AND payments.status = 'PAID' AND payments.confirmed_at >= #{from} AND payments.confirmed_at < #{to} UNION ALL SELECT DATE(service_bookings.confirmed_at) AS date, CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(15,2)) AS salesRevenue, service_bookings.agreed_price AS serviceRevenue, 0 AS paidSessionCount FROM service_bookings WHERE service_bookings.store_id = #{storeId} AND service_bookings.payment_status = 'PAID' AND service_bookings.confirmed_at >= #{from} AND service_bookings.confirmed_at < #{to}
mapper.select: SELECT date, SUM(paidSessionCount) AS paidSessionCount, SUM(salesRevenue) AS salesRevenue, SUM(serviceRevenue) AS serviceRevenue, SUM(salesRevenue + serviceRevenue) AS revenue FROM () revenue_data GROUP BY date ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT orders.created_at AS createdAt, orders.order_number AS orderNumber, dining_tables.code AS tableCode, sales_sessions.opened_by_customer_name AS customerName, orders.original_amount AS originalAmount, orders.payable_amount AS payableAmount
ORDER BY orders.created_at DESC, orders.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT order_item_cancellation_requests.resolved_at AS resolvedAt, orders.order_number AS orderNumber, dining_tables.code AS tableCode, order_items.item_name AS itemName, order_item_cancellation_requests.requested_quantity AS quantity, order_item_cancellation_requests.reason AS reason, order_item_cancellation_requests.resolved_by_name AS resolvedByName
ORDER BY order_item_cancellation_requests.resolved_at DESC, order_item_cancellation_requests.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
